$comment: Family Hub Home Maintenance — seed task record schema. All seed library research output must conform to this. One JSON object per task; deliverable is an array. SCHEMA v2 (B1.5 gap-closure): applicability vocabulary expanded from equipment-presence tags to equipment-presence + equipment-VARIANT tags so the Home Profile can enable the correct task set per appliance type (e.g. tank vs tankless water heater). v1 records remain valid; the only breaking fix is 'tile' -> 'tile_surfaces'.

task_record.name: Short display name
task_record.description_howto: 2-4 sentence description including a brief how-to
task_record.category: HVAC | Plumbing | Electrical/Safety | Exterior | Interior | Appliances | Landscape/Irrigation | Pest | Seasonal
task_record.location: Room/zone tag (Kitchen, Master Bath, Roof, Yard, Garage, Whole Home...)
task_record.lead_time_days: integer — how far ahead it surfaces as upcoming
task_record.est_cost_pro: number USD (typical service), null if never hired out
products: product ids/names consumed, empty array if none
task_record.assignable: boolean — suitable to assign to a family member via Chores bridge
applicability: only include tags that gate this task — see applicability_tags. Empty array = universal to all homes.
task_record.surprise_factor: low | med | high — high = most homeowners don't know they should do this

applicability_tags.$comment: Full controlled vocabulary for task_record.applicability. Presence tags gate optional equipment/features; variant tags gate mutually-exclusive appliance types. The Home Profile (scope doc Section 3.4) must ask a question that resolves every tag used by an enabled seed task. Variant tag groups marked 'exclusive' should render as a single-select profile question.

roof_type.profile_question: Roof type: Tile / Shingle (already in v1)

heating_type.profile_question: Primary heating: Gas furnace / Heat pump / Electric. Reserved — no current seed task is gated on these (annual heating tune-up applies to all); tags exist so future variant tasks and B2 cost records can differentiate.

dryer_fuel.profile_question: Dryer fuel: Gas / Electric. Reserved — vent/lint tasks apply to both; a gas dryer additionally resolves gas_service for the connector inspection.

notes: 'gas_service' means the home has natural gas or propane service to ANY appliance; it gates the gas connector/shutoff inspection. A profile answer of gas furnace, gas dryer, gas range, gas water heater, or gas fireplace should set it automatically.

'fireplace' remains the umbrella tag for the annual NFPA 211 chimney/flue inspection, which applies to wood-burning and gas hearths alike. Split into wood/gas variants only if a variant-specific task is ever added.
'tile_surfaces' replaces the v1 ad-hoc 'tile' tag (used by grout_reseal). Migration: rewrite 'tile' -> 'tile_surfaces' on import.
Reserved tags with no seed tasks yet (add tasks before exposing profile questions): evap_cooler (populated in the B3 Desert Southwest pass), electric_heat, gas_dryer, electric_dryer.

big_ticket_record.$comment: Separate table for sinking-fund assets. B1.5 note: the water-heater entry must be split by variant — tank (10-15 yr life) vs tankless (~20 yr life) — because expected_life_years drives target_balance_today. Add water softener (10-15 yr) to the asset list.
big_ticket_record.name: Water Heater (Tank), Water Heater (Tankless), HVAC, Tile Roof Underlayment, Exterior Repaint, Carpet, Garage Springs, Water Softener, RO System...
big_ticket_record.notes: AZ-specific life adjustments (sun, hard water) where relevant
